nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Under Eye Bags Daytime Treatment

avis.texte: I LOVE LOVE LOVE this product! It does *exactly* what it claims to do. I've had bags under my eyes my whole life. This is the first treatment I've ever found that pretty much makes them COMPLETELY disappear. I recently traveled for work, which only makes the puffiness under my eyes more pronounced . I took this with me so I wouldn't look so exhausted while I was giving presentations , and it delivered! There are a few things to know about using this. 1) It does nothing to treat discoloration under the eyes. This addresses puffiness and bags only. 2) There's a learning curve. You don't want to overwork it. Make sure you've put on any treatments or makeup under your eyes, then tap in lightly. Overworking it will cause your makeup to separate. I also use a very small amount (not pea-sized. Less) 3) You really do need to give it about 15 minutes to completely set. Keeping a neutral expression is super important , or then you end up with creased eye bags (yay!). I usually put on my complexion makeup and blush (if you accidentally work over this with a brush while it's setting, game over), add this treatment, and then do my lids/brows/lashes and hair while I let it do its thing. 4) It does make the skin feel a tiny bit tight. It feels a little odd at first. Not uncomfortable (for me at least), just odd. 5) This gets me through a full 9 hour workday without looking older or tired. By the time I'm going to bed, it's definitely time to wash off, but otherwise, this stuff is pretty muc
